## Per-section scores

Score each section on the 0–100 scale defined in
`commons/standard/LexGrade_Standard_v1.0.md`. Leave a section blank only if
you found the rubric impossible to apply (and explain why under "Scoring
notes" below).

| Section | Weight | Your score (0–100) |
|---|---|---|
| I. Threshold Compliance (gate — pass/fail) | gate | |
| II-A. Problem Diagnosis | 10% | |
| II-B. Legal Analysis & Authority | 20% | |
| III. Factual Presentation & Evidentiary Support | 18% | |
| IV. Writing Quality & Organization | 12% | |
| V. Strategic Sophistication | 10% | |
| VI. Ethical Compliance (gate — pass/fail) | gate | |
| VII. Self-Assessment & Limitations | 10% | |

**Section I (Threshold) result:** PASS / FAIL
**Section VI (Ethical) result:** PASS / FAIL

## Scoring notes

Anything that was hard to score, ambiguous in the rubric, or where you felt
the weighting produced an unintuitive result. **This is the most valuable
part of the submission.** Rubric refinement happens here.

## Agreement / divergence vs the published score

The Scoring Guide publishes Exemplar A = 95.6, B = 80.1, C = 0. After
submitting your scores above, look at the published score for the exemplar
you graded and write 2-4 sentences on whether your score agreed, diverged,
and what (if anything) the divergence suggests about the rubric.
